newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to start OFZ bonds with 500 bln rbl tranche.
newsitem.headline: Russia to start OFZ bonds with 500 bln rbl tranche.

text.p: Russia will start trading a 500 billion rouble first tranche of fixed-rate OFZ interest-bearing government bonds on Monday, the Central Bank said in a statement.

The tranche, to be traded on the Moscow Interbank Currency Exchange (MICEX), is the first of twelve. Central Bank First Deputy Chairman Sergei Aleksashenko said on Thursday they would be worth a total of 3.8 trillion roubles.
The nominal value of each bond is one million roubles.
The Finance Ministry issued the three-year paper, paying fixed interest of 20 percent a year, on June 6, 1996.
The bond is scheduled to pay its coupons on June 6, 1997, June 6, 1998 and June 6, 1999, the statement said.
Aleksashenko said the bonds were not subject to a 15 percent tax on government securities, as they were issued before the tax came into force.
